mentions.name: Hatamoto
mentions.description: A self-contained platform intended as a complete replacement for WordPress and its most-used plugins, shipped as a single Go binary with no Node or compilation step. Runs on PostgreSQL, supports sandboxed plugins, and includes built-in AI analytics.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://hatamoto.dev - a complete replacement to Wordpress and its most used plugins built into the system. One go binary, no node , no compilation, Postgres and sandboxes plugins. Built in AI analytics
mentions.author: zenincognito
